A '''Bubbleback''' was a variant of a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]. The variant originated from [[Teyr Rift]] and was popular for exploring the rift's bottom, though it wasn't practical for [[City/Legends|cities]]. The bubbleback had a [[Refresher/Legends|compact waste station]] and reprocessor with [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] fittings. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell]] used one on [[Teyr/Legends|Teyr]].
